Hi Jordan —

Thanks — looping in Legal (Aditya) and our Contracts lead (Laura) to confirm the exact language. For speed, I attached a PDF of the redlined MSA showing the insurance section we usually accept, plus a short checklist your broker can follow.

Quick summary of what we typically require for deals at this tier (happy to adjust if you need exceptions):
- Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
- Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000 aggregate (claims-made with retroactive date equal to policy inception)
- Cyber/Privacy: $1,000,000 (where applicable)
- Waiver of subrogation: not required by default, but can be discussed
- Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, Inc. to be named on GL on a primary and non-contributory basis when requested by Redwood for product-related integrations
- Cancellation: 30 days for most carriers; certain carriers limit notice to 30 days — Aditya will flag if we need escalation to exceptions.

Next steps:
1) Aditya will confirm final redline language (expect markup today).
2) Jordan / Mark, please ask your broker to produce a sample COI and a one-page broker note confirming they can issue the endorsement described. Attach those to the thread and we can triage.
3) Once legal signs off, we will issue an updated Order Form via DocuSign (link to follow).

Attached: redlined_msa.pdf (insurance section highlighted)

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, North America
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Hannah —

Thanks — I reviewed the redline. A few notes and proposed language we prefer so procurement can accept COI/endorsement deliverables without legal rework: 

1) Additional Insured:
   - Proposed clause (GL only): "The Contractor shall name Redwood Inference, Inc. and its subsidiaries as additional insureds under the Commercial General Liability policy, with endorsement CG 20 10 (or equivalent) providing Additional Insured status on a primary and non-contributory basis with respect to claims arising out of the Contractor's work under this Agreement."

2) Professional Liability (E&O):
   - Claims-made policy acceptable. Minimum limit $2,000,000 aggregate. Retroactive date: policy inception date or earlier — we require the retroactive date to precede the commencement of services.

3) Cyber/Privacy:
   - Minimum $1,000,000 for vendors handling customer data; not required for strictly infrastructure access-only deals.

4) Cancellation:
   - Standard: certificate must show "30 days' advance written notice of cancellation, non-renewal or material change." If carrier will only provide 10/30 day notice, procurement escalation may be required.

5) Certificate Wording:
   - On the COI: Redwood Inference, Inc.
     1234 Market St, Suite 700
     San Francisco, CA 94103
   - Endorsement: when Additional Insured requested, broker must provide GL endorsement sample that mirrors CG 20 10 or equivalent; COI alone is insufficient to satisfy Additional Insured requirement in our legal review.

If Acme's broker can provide (a) COI showing the limits above, (b) an insurer-signed endorsement or a broker affidavit confirming they will issue the endorsement, and (c) the retroactive date on PLI if claims-made, we can proceed to finalize the Order Form.

Attached: redlined_msa.pdf (insurance section with proposed language)

- Aditya
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
